card.name: Word after a modifier, before a noun
card.fires_on: A noun or adverb that sits right after a modifier and leads into a second noun, most often "blood" before levels, pressure or viscosity. It also fires on "vivo" in "in vitro and in vivo" and on "patient" in "patient response".
